details.description: Machine-readable facts for codes that need them, for example `commitment_price_changed`: `lines` (offeringId, quotedUnitPriceMinor, unitPriceMinor, lineTotalMinor), `totalMinor` and `currency`.

paidMinor.description: Sum of the active (not reversed) payment entries.
paidMinor.title: Paidminor

paymentRecorded.description: An active payment entry is booked; it blocks the order cancellation.
paymentRecorded.title: Paymentrecorded

recipientEmail.description: The e-mail address frozen on the invoice. Its cancellation invoice is sent there; it can differ from the order's current invoice recipient.
recipientEmail.title: Recipientemail

delivered.description: Marked delivered on the delivery board; blocks cancellation.

capturedAt.description: When an acquirer saved the order on the device, if it was sent from the PWA queue. `createdAt` of the order list stays the server time and drives lists, weekly values and invoices.

deliveryCompletionVersion.title: Deliverycompletionversion

capturedAt.description: When the capture was saved on the device (ISO 8601 with offset), sent by the PWA offline queue; acquisition source only. With it, every line needs `quotedUnitPriceMinor` and a price that differs from the server price is refused with 409 `commitment_price_changed` (details: new unit prices and total). At most 14 days before and 5 minutes after the server time, otherwise 422 `captured_at_out_of_range`. Rights, prices, windows and suppression are still checked at send time.
capturedAt.title: Capturedat

enabled.description: The action has the donations capability.

startPoint.description: Absent: the stored start point stays. Null: no start point.

capturedAt.description: When the capture was saved on the device (ISO 8601 with offset), sent by the PWA offline queue. It becomes `occurredAt` of the activity. assignmentRevision.description: The assignment revision this activity produced; for a contact kept on a moved assignment (`assignmentUpdated` false) the revision it met. Stable across replays.

donations.description: The part "Spenden". Null: the club takes no donations. Omitted by a client from before this field: the previous value is kept.

post.description:
Record that the money received for a cancelled invoice went back.

LeonAid books no refund; this closes the reminder "Erstattung offen".
A finance record like a payment reversal, with the same gate: fresh login
and ``Idempotency-Key``. The same key again returns the stored marker
(``replayed``); another command on a settled refund answers 409
``invoice_refund_already_settled``.
